findings.mechanism: The ordinary speech carrier at qul meets the attributed split-root smallness facet and the terminal aḥad predicate, so formal reduction becomes a local image of concentrated saying.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact form itself performs the concentration its content asserts.
findings.containment: This is an attributed exploratory mapped-root echo, not the lexical translation of qul and not a claim that the q-l-l target replaces the dominant saying reading.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus trace supplies the split-root role and explicit containment, but its reader source is legacy_unbound and the trace marks the reading exploratory.
